summary: Completed comprehensive testing of India Explorer tourism website. Backend APIs are fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend loads correctly with all core features working, but identified critical UI overlay issue preventing complete user workflow testing.

ui_bugs.issue: Search modal overlay cannot be closed properly - X button not clickable and backdrop click not working

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix search overlay modal close functionality - the X button and backdrop click are not working properly, preventing users from closing the search modal and continuing with map navigation. This blocks the complete user workflow testing.
